name: pg_station_main
notes: Base station: an orange steel capsule, 15.6 m by 15.9 m with its annex and 27.2 m to the mast top, with a wet lab and moon pool at the bottom, floors every 3 m with a spiral stair, a radar room with amber screens at the top, a dish on the roof, an annex capsule and a landing stage on the west side. The walkway door and landing are at 4.5 m on the +Z side.
